CREATE TABLE "public"."balance_purchase" (
  "amount_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "balance_purchase_status_check_37d7c798" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."model_pricing" (
  "cents_per_1k_input" numeric NOT NULL,
  "cents_per_1k_output" numeric NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_default" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."token_usage" (
  "actual_cost_cents" numeric,
  "amount_cents" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "input_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "job_id" text NOT NULL,
  "job_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "openrouter_generation_ids" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "output_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "token_usage_job_kind_check_74df029d" CHECK ("job_kind" IN ('SUGGESTION', 'TAILOR')),
  CONSTRAINT "token_usage_openrouter_generation_ids_elem_not_null_73635ad0" CHECK (array_position("openrouter_generation_ids", NULL) IS NULL)
)
